name: Nagisa Youan
source:
The protagonist and viewpoint character. A youkai invisible to most humans.
He is deeply loyal to his friend Shuuya and driven by a strong sense of justice to uncover the truth behind his disappearance. He is curious about the human world and forms bonds easily with those who can perceive him.
translation:
The protagonist and viewpoint character. A youkai invisible to most humans.
He is deeply loyal to his friend Shuuya and driven by a strong sense of justice to uncover the truth behind his disappearance. He is curious about the human world and forms bonds easily with those who can perceive him.
